campbell.title: Campbell City Council — August 18, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered several administrative items, including selecting voting delegates for the 2026 League of California Cities annual conference, a resolution amending the city's agreement for city clerk services, and a grant acceptance presented by the police department's captain. The Council also took up a governance-related item concerning the BART Silicon Valley project.
keyTopics: Designation of voting delegates for the 2026 League of California Cities annual conference
Resolution amending the first amended agreement for city clerk services
Police department grant acceptance, presented by the police captain
Governance matters related to the BART Silicon Valley project

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — August 19, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up a routine mix of contracts and approvals, including janitorial services, irrigation maintenance, a GIS consultant amendment, and playground replacement at Bellgrove Park, along with a budget amendment and final map approvals for several small lot subdivisions. The Council also considered a contested appeal involving a 25-lot residential subdivision on Pierce Road, a new five-year law enforcement contract with the Santa Clara County Sheriff's Office, and electrification upgrades at city facilities.
keyTopics: Appeal of Planning Commission's denial of a 25-lot residential subdivision on Pierce Road, including its Environmental Impact Report
Five-year law enforcement services agreement with the Santa Clara County Sheriff's Office
Contracts for Bellgrove Park playground replacement and city irrigation maintenance for FY 2026-27
Purchase of electrical equipment to replace gas systems at Warner Hutton House, Civic Center Theater, and Joan Pisani Community Center
No Parking Anytime zone proposed for Chester Avenue and Arcadia Palms Drive

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — August 25, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council considered several infrastructure and housing items, including a roof replacement contract for the History Museum, an EV charger installation project at the Maintenance Yard, and completion of the Woodland Library patio expansion. The Council also held a public hearing on a resident petition to rename Lee Street to Tubman Street, and reviewed two condominium development proposals on Vesting Tentative Maps at First Street and at Sherwood/Acacia Avenues.
keyTopics: Public hearing on renaming Lee Street to Tubman Street
Vesting Tentative Map for 19 condominium units at 349 First Street
Vesting Tentative Map for 33 condominium units at Sherwood and Acacia Avenues
Contracts for the History Museum roof replacement and Maintenance Yard EV chargers
Draft responses to Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole claims and BART Silicon Valley Phase II oversight

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — August 18, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council reviewed routine administrative business, including meeting minutes, financial reports, and payment registers, along with a professional services agreement and an amendment to an existing contract. The Council also considered an omnibus ordinance making minor updates to the Town Code, selected a voting delegate for an upcoming League of California Cities event, and took up a request regarding whether to continue or proceed with a public hearing on pending appeals.
keyTopics: Approval of the August 4, 2026 Town Council meeting minutes
A professional services agreement and a second amendment to an existing agreement
Monthly financial and investment report for June 2026, plus accounts payable and payroll reports
Appointment of a voting delegate and alternate for the League of California Cities Annual event
An omnibus ordinance amending the Town Code with minor updates, and a decision on continuing or hearing a pending appeal

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — August 26, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole reviewed the planned agendas for upcoming City Council meetings, including the final agenda for September 1, 2026, while the September 8, 2026 meeting was cancelled. The committee also considered the public record covering August 13-20, 2026, and an appointment to the VEBA Advisory Committee, along with plans for a joint special meeting with the San José/Santa Clara Treatment Plant Advisory Committee.
keyTopics: Review and additions to the September 1, 2026 Final Agenda
Cancellation of the September 8, 2026 Draft Agenda
Public Record review for August 13-20, 2026
VEBA Advisory Committee appointment
Joint Special Meeting with the San José/Santa Clara Treatment Plant Advisory Committee

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee — August 31, 2026
mountain-view.summary: Mountain View's Youth Advisory Committee held an organizational meeting covering how open-meeting rules work and what the committee's purpose is, along with a team-building activity. Members also brainstormed ideas for their work plan for the upcoming fiscal year.
keyTopics: Overview of the Brown Act and Robert's Rules of Order
Discussion of the Youth Advisory Committee's role
Brainstorming for the FY 2026-27 work plan
Team-building exercise
Public comment period (Oral Communications)

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — August 25, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council held a special meeting on August 25, 2026, that began with a closed session before an open portion of the meeting. The open session included a presentation with an update on the CleanWater Program.
keyTopics: Closed session (special meeting)
CleanWater Program update presentation

cupertino.title: Cupertino Teen Commission — August 12, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino Teen Commission met to discuss plans for a Bike Fest event, a Juvenile Traffic Diversion Program, and a presentation from a youth-led organization called Next Vision AI. The Commission also considered approval of minutes from its June 10, 2026 meeting, and members of the public had an opportunity to raise other topics not on the agenda.
keyTopics: Bike Fest planning
Juvenile Traffic Diversion Program
Presentation from youth-led organization Next Vision AI
Approval of June 10, 2026 meeting minutes

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — August 25, 2026
santa-clara.summary: This Santa Clara City Council meeting was held in a hybrid format, with in-person attendance at City Hall along with Zoom and phone options for public participation. One councilmember, Chahal, participated remotely from India. The agenda excerpt provided does not include details on specific policy items considered.
keyTopics: Councilmember Chahal's remote participation from Panchkula, India
Hybrid meeting format with in-person, Zoom, and phone access for the public

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — August 11, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council considered introducing an ordinance to amend part of the city's municipal code, and received an educational presentation on municipal bonds basics. The meeting also included routine business such as approving prior meeting minutes and reviewing upcoming agenda items.
keyTopics: Introduction of an ordinance amending Municipal Code Title XIII, Chapters B.6
Presentation on Municipal Bonds 101 from Finance staff
Review of the City Council calendar of upcoming meetings
Approval of prior City Council meeting minutes
Preview of anticipated items for the next regular City Council meeting

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Economic Development Committee — August 26, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Economic Development Committee reviewed a proposed strategy for retaining, expanding, and attracting local businesses, along with a staff report on recent economic development activity for August 2026. The discussion focused on how the city supports its business community and tracks economic trends.
keyTopics: Business Retention, Expansion, and Attraction (BRE/A) Strategy staff presentation
Economic Development Activity Report for August 2026
